specialtyScope: baseline/lock supersession, creator runnability with pinned uv, starting-HEAD existence/ancestry, lane-history absence, dynamic closure of every prelock review file, progress pending gate, immutable baseline/current bytes, and direct-child lock validation
summary: The three candidate-1 S2 defects are fixed and the targeted controls pass, but the exact candidate cannot complete the mandatory lock lifecycle. The creator emits and can commit a direct-child v2 lock, after which the full pinned validator fails because the manifest freezes a deliberately Git-ignored FAQ PDF while post-lock validation requires every frozen path to exist as a baseline Git blob.

findings.title: The lock creator emits a v2 lock that the mandatory post-lock validator cannot accept

evidence.detail: Rulebook PDFs are explicitly local and ignored by Git.
Post-lock validation iterates the combined frozen manifest maps and requires git show <baseline>:<path> to succeed for every path, reporting frozen file absent from baseline otherwise.
The creator runs only --prelock validation and then writes the lock; that prelock mode cannot exercise the later baseline-blob requirement.

steps: Create a local shared clone at exact candidate ee42f3522859d1dd7ce782c801023cb71fd53071.
Stage source trees from the locked candidate worktree; 1,098 files copied, 1,114 tracked source files byte-checked.
Run python3 scripts/create_correctness_audit_lock.py; it exits 0 and creates a 53-file stage1-v2 lock.
Commit only audit-lock.json as direct child 160b33d8170c2351d95e0d6796a0f90d1a03f9a6 of the candidate.
Run the full validator with uv --isolated and requirements-audit.txt.
Observe exit 1 with the sole failure: frozen file absent from baseline: docs/rulebooks/Nemesis_RT_FAQ_v1.2.pdf.
git ls-files --error-unmatch for that PDF exits 1; git check-ignore -v identifies .gitignore:2.

observed.fullValidatorFailure: frozen file absent from baseline: docs/rulebooks/Nemesis_RT_FAQ_v1.2.pdf

findings.impact: No Stage 1 v2 baseline produced from this candidate can satisfy the documented post-lock gate under the repository's current source-tracking policy, so the candidate cannot be promoted and no audit unit may leave pending-blind-derivation.
findings.recommendedFix: Make the baseline-byte contract distinguish Git-backed frozen artifacts from intentionally gitignored, hash-pinned source inputs, while continuing to require the staged source bytes to match the frozen manifest hash; alternatively place the FAQ PDF in a durable baseline object intentionally. Add an end-to-end regression that starts from a clean isolated clone, stages sources, runs the creator, commits only the direct-child lock, and requires the full pinned validator to pass. The creator should also reject any baseline that cannot satisfy the eventual post-lock frozen-path checks before it writes a lock.

candidate1FindingVerification.detail: sys is imported, the creator is runnable, and the generated prelock command uses uv run --isolated --with-requirements with jsonschema[format]==4.25.1 pinned. The exact pinned prelock validation passes, and an actual isolated creator run exits 0.

Creator-level cat-file and merge-base checks reject missing and non-ancestor starting commits; the focused negative control passes. The real lockedStartingHead resolves to a commit and is an ancestor of the candidate.
scripts/stage_correctness_audit_sources.py --check verifies all 1,098 required source files in the review worktree, and the helper successfully provisions an isolated clone before creator execution.

baselineSupersession.detail: audit-lock-v1.json has the same Git blob ac7a9aabbada905777fdd07f9c3814730835be69 as audit-lock.json in v1 lock commit 3e23aebf52bac07ca54829fb49e4eb1f375bf599; that commit is the direct child of v1 baseline 2fe3f0da7da6e462bbcdcca7db29571b52a2d27c. No active v2 audit-lock.json is tracked at the candidate.

startingHead.detail: 8d95b94f3e5c8d5ffb3a1c9835dd2512be88bc93 exists as a commit and merge-base --is-ancestor against the candidate exits 0.

laneHistoryAbsence.detail: No packet, blind, comparison, adjudication, or reviews/raw path appears from lockedStartingHead through the candidate; no merge commit exists in that range.

dynamicPrelockReviewClosure.detail: required_locked_files dynamically walks reviews/ while excluding reviews/raw. Focused mutation control passes. The generated lock contained all 31 of 31 current prelock review files with no missing or unexpected review path.

progressPendingGate.detail: All 140 units are pending-blind-derivation; nonPending and rowsWithArtifacts are empty, declared counts reconcile, and creator-level pending enforcement is present.

immutableLockedBytes.detail: All 53 generated locked-file hashes matched both candidate baseline blobs and current bytes; the lock's own current bytes matched its direct-child commit. The separate frozen-source baseline requirement is the blocker reported as S2-004.

directChildLock.detail: The temporary lock commit was a single-parent direct child of the candidate and retained identical lock bytes; direct-child, intervening-commit, later-mutation, path-history, and same-wave controls all pass. Full post-lock validation still fails for S2-004.

testsRun.detail: 73/73 tests passed, including creator runnability, missing/non-ancestor starting HEAD, dynamic review closure, direct-child seal, lane-history, immutable history, and progress controls

probeArtifacts.purpose: Compare generated lock review closure, baseline/current bytes, pending progress, starting ancestry, lane history, and direct-child lock bytes without editing the candidate.
Ephemeral shared clone used for the actual creator/direct-child/full-validator lifecycle.

residualRisks: No downstream lane artifact exists at this prelock candidate, so real packet-to-adjudication history is not yet available; adversarial controls cover those mechanics but do not replace later exact-history validation.

The direct-child lifecycle was necessarily exercised in an isolated local clone because the assigned review worktree was read-only; the clone used the exact candidate and exact staged source bytes and was removed afterward.
